description: This file defines an abstract class BearerTokenIdentity within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing the use of Bearer Token credentials, and declares an abstract method getExpiration().

classes.name: BearerTokenIdentity
classes.description: An abstract class representing Bearer Token credentials, providing an interface for retrieving token expiration details.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Abstract method to return the expiration timestamp of the Bearer Token, or null if not available.
